summary: The retained Kubernetes startup test was functionally correct but flaky under concurrent test processes because it shared the production lock path and used timing-based overlap detection.
validation: Independent review passed wrapper, argv, environment, prefetch-failure, and serial checks.
Independent review observed 11 failures in 40 concurrent test runs.
The live cluster was not mutated by this review.
blockers: Replace sleep-based overlap detection with deterministic synchronization and isolate concurrent test processes before approval.
next_action: Route to code: add a test-level lock and FIFO barrier so both persistent children announce startup before release, then rerun serial and concurrent tests.
independent_lanes: Deterministic Kubernetes child startup regression coverage

issues.title: Startup regression test is flaky under concurrent invocations
issues.details: The test used sleeps and the production global lock path, allowing separate test processes to interfere. A FIFO barrier and test-level serialization are required.
